info.name: API-1738 - Display Passengers - Lightweight evidence collection
info.description: Evidence collection backed by six pre-generated paid QA PNRs. It never creates a PNR, journey, passenger, guest fee, or payment. For test cases that cover GET /Booking it creates only a temporary Manage Booking basket and loads the existing PNR. Each test case applies its own BookingRules/BookingVerify configuration, performs the official evidence calls, and restores the previous configuration. PNRs were generated on 2026-08-31 for travel 14-21 days later; regenerate them after departure or if test data is modified.

item.description: Lightweight evidence flow for TC04 (test matrix row 4). Applies the same rule-fails configuration as TC02 on passenger-coverage PNR {{api1738SeedPassengerCoveragePnr}}, but loads the booking with flowType Booking instead of Manage.
